note: The ladder rules agreed the morning of 9/17. The Ladder tab renders this file; the monitor's pushes carry the same plays. Edit here, not in index.html.

rules.rule: New longs only with BTC's daily close above its 50 day. Below it no new money enters. Open positions keep their own exits.
Rotate bands only on monthly closes. Under 15 uses MSTX. 15 to 50 uses MSTR. 50 to 85 uses IBIT. 85 and up is the sell zone. A touch does not trigger rotation.
Buy 12 months and sell 90 days. Roll the short leg.
Buy 0.75 delta and sell the band ceiling. Carry the ceiling to the short expiry. MSTX uses the 15 line. Enter that BTC price in BITCOIN PRICE LOOKUP. Set the short expiry to get the strike.
Enter at zero gap or below while Rich is off. Cheap is the add. Never open a primary while Rich is on.
Size the primary by phase. Use 80% of the sleeve on 9/17. Use 70% on 9/26. Use 60% at LEAPS and after. Keep two 10% gap sleeves and a growing cash floor.

Exit when the monthly close crosses the band. The short strike is the trigger. When the gate flips down roll the short call lower and closer. Use 30 to 45 days. Keep the long. At the 85 line sell the BTC beta and rotate down.

phase_note: Phase 2 (Jan long / Dec 18 short, decided 9/15) stays as written at 70%. The time and strike rules bind from Phase 3, the LEAPS, on.

history.note: monthly closes since 2013 on the ladder's own bands

bands.note: the current visit began 2026-03 and is 6.5 months in, the longest on record. With the bounces into the 15 to 50 band counted, the 2015-16 and 2022-23 bottoms ran 13 to 16 months. That is the case for the 12-month long.
the three bull peaks ran 10, 11 and 16 months, plus two pokes of 1 and 3; last monthly close above 85: 2022-03

history.tops_note: The peaks step down and the 2024 top at $97.5k never reached the 85 line. The 85 line is where the BTC beta gets sold, not a place to sit. If 2024 is the shape, the upper half of the cycle plays out in the IBIT band and Rich readings there are the sell.
